Consider the following correct implementation of the selection sort algorithm．The method sorts an ArrayList of integers into ascending order．

public static void selectionSort(ArrayList<Integer> elements)
{
    for (int j = 0; j < elements.size() - 1; j++) // Line 1
    {
        int index = j;
        for (int k = j + 1; k < elements.size(); k++) // Line 2
        {
            if (elements.get(k) < elements.get(index)) // Line 3
            {
                index = k;
            }
        }
        int temp = elements.get(j);
        elements.set(j, elements.get(index));
        elements.set(index, temp);

}
